summary: 不定式可作主语、宾语、表语、定语、状语和宾补，表目的、将来或具体某次动作。

rules.title: 作主语：常用 it 作形式主语
rules.detail: It is + 形容词/noun + to do。真正的主语是后面的不定式。

examples.en: It is important to learn from mistakes.
It took me two hours to finish the report.
examples.zh: 完成报告花了我两个小时。

rules.title: 常见接不定式的动词与句型
rules.detail: afford, agree, decide, expect, fail, hope, manage, offer, plan, promise, refuse, want + to do；be able to / have to / used to + do。

examples.en: They managed to solve the problem in time.
examples.zh: 他们设法及时解决了问题。

examples.en: He promised to keep it a secret.

rules.title: 不定式的否定式与省略 to
rules.detail: 否定式在 to 前加 not：Tell him not to be late. 使役/感官动词（make, let, have, see, hear, watch, feel）后接省 to 不定式：I saw him enter the room.（被动语态中 to 要还原：He was seen to enter the room.）

examples.en: The teacher made us retell the story.
He was made to work all night.

pitfalls: make/see 等被动后漏 to：❌ He was seen cross the road. → ✓ He was seen to cross the road.
not 位置错误：❌ to not be late → ✓ not to be late
it 形式主语结构分裂：❌ To finish it is took two hours. → ✓ It took two hours to finish it.

questions.stem: It's very kind of you ___ me with the luggage.
questions.explain: It is + 形容词 + of sb + to do 固定句型，用 to help。

questions.stem: The doctor advised him ___ smoking immediately.
questions.explain: advise sb to do sth：建议某人做某事。

questions.stem: We saw him ___ the building and then take a taxi.
questions.explain: 感官动词 see 后接省 to 不定式：saw him leave。

questions.stem: He was often made ___ overtime by his boss.
questions.explain: make 变为被动语态后要还原 to：be made to work。

questions.stem: My mother told me ___ (not stay) up too late.
questions.explain: tell sb not to do：不定式否定式 not to do。

questions.stem: It takes about 30 minutes ___ (get) to the airport by taxi.
questions.explain: It takes + 时间 + to do 固定句型。

questions.stem: He refused answering the question in public.
questions.explain: refuse 后接不定式：refused to answer。

questions.stem: 学好一门外语需要耐心。（翻译整句）
answer: learning a foreign language well takes patience.
it takes patience to learn a foreign language well.
to learn a foreign language well takes patience.
questions.explain: 可用动名词或不定式作主语；It takes... to do 更常见。

questions.stem: 为了不吵醒孩子，她轻手轻脚地走进了房间。（翻译整句，wake）
answer: she entered the room quietly so as not to wake the child.
she walked into the room quietly in order not to wake up the child.
questions.explain: 不定式否定 so as not to / in order not to 表示「为了不……」。
